question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick/full GitHub PR templates as the contributor authoring contract, assuming current-head rendered proof is added?
rationale: This changes the default contributor workflow and the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing product decision, so automation should not treat the template policy as purely mechanical.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Accept the quick/full template split once the contributor adds current-head rendered proof showing the HTML-comment cleanup behaves as intended.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for narrower or different template wording, such as extra contributor guidance or stricter evidence language, before merge.

options.title: Keep the single template
options.body: Reject selectable PR templates for now and leave or close the linked issue based on that product decision.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the quick/full template split once the contributor adds current-head rendered proof showing the HTML-comment cleanup behaves as intended.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest history on the PR template surface and prior submission-guidance consolidation.
